newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit mulls spin-off - HK paper.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit mulls spin-off - HK paper.

text.p: Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd is considering spinning off its electrical appliances divsion, the Hong Kong Standard said on Wednesday.
The paper quoted chairman Wong Shi-ling as saying the company hoped to list the division in the first quarter of 1997.
Leading Spirit executives were not immediately available for comment.
Wong said the company needed extra funding for its industrial estate in Jiangmen and to expand business.
Leading Spirit Shares hit a record high of HK$4.95, up HK$0.15 before retreating slightly to HK$4.925 in early trade.
